name: RimWorld
short_description: A colony sim where a story generator throws events at a handful of survivors on a rim planet.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: A colony sim where a story generator throws events at a handful of survivors on a rim planet.

identity.core_loop: Give orders, build, farm, survive raids, disease and weather, watch stories happen.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Characters' moods are bubbles and needs lists; lots of overlay tabs; the storyteller picks events.

identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: An AI storyteller that paces events is a director we want, kid-friendly; but keep the needs on the characters, not in tabs.
